description: This file contains the definition of the SugarFieldDatetime class, which extends the SugarFieldBase class to provide functionality for handling datetime fields within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM system. The class includes methods for rendering edit, search, and detail views, as well as for processing input data and sanitizing import data related to datetime fields.

classes.name: SugarFieldDatetime
classes.description: A class that manages the display and processing of datetime fields within the CRM, including rendering forms, handling input, and formatting for display.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Renders the edit view for datetime fields, configuring display parameters and handling special cases for certain field names.

methods.name: getImportViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares and renders the import view for datetime fields, setting default display parameters.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Renders the search view for datetime fields, including range searches.

methods.name: getEmailTemplateValue
methods.description: Provides a formatted datetime value suitable for email templates, in user display format.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes input data to save datetime values into the bean object, handling format checking and conversions.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes and converts input datetime string into a database format for import purposes.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares the display of datetime fields in detail views, ensuring proper formatting.
